title: Understanding Cryptocurrency: Step-by-Step Guide
description: A beginner-friendly guide to understanding cryptocurrency, from the basics of blockchain to wallets, exchanges, and the future of digital money.

nodes.label: What is Cryptocurrency?
nodes.description: Cryptocurrency is a digital form of money that uses cryptography for security. It operates on decentralized networks called blockchains, making it different from traditional money controlled by banks or governments.

nodes.label: What is Blockchain?
nodes.description: Blockchain is a digital ledger technology that records transactions across many computers. It ensures transparency, security, and immutability of cryptocurrency transactions.

nodes.label: Bitcoin (BTC)
nodes.description: Bitcoin is the first and most well-known cryptocurrency, created in 2009 by Satoshi Nakamoto. It is often referred to as 'digital gold' and is widely used as a store of value.

nodes.label: Altcoins
nodes.description: Altcoins are cryptocurrencies other than Bitcoin, such as Ethereum, Litecoin, and Ripple. Many altcoins focus on smart contracts, faster transactions, or specific use cases.

nodes.label: Crypto Wallets
nodes.description: A wallet is a digital tool to store your cryptocurrency. Hot wallets are connected to the internet (e.g., apps), while cold wallets are offline and safer from hacking.

nodes.label: Crypto Exchanges
nodes.description: Exchanges are platforms where you can buy, sell, and trade cryptocurrencies. Popular ones include Binance, Coinbase, and Kraken. They charge fees for transactions.

nodes.label: Risks of Cryptocurrency
nodes.description: Crypto markets are highly volatile. Risks include hacking, scams, regulatory changes, and losing private keys. Always research before investing.

nodes.label: Future of Cryptocurrency
nodes.description: Cryptocurrencies may shape the future of finance through decentralized finance (DeFi), central bank digital currencies (CBDCs), and blockchain adoption across industries.
